title: Metallics
description: Adds decor blocks for all metals to match copper.
body:
Adds a large range of metallic building blocks for every vanilla metal type(modded ones planned). I love copper building blocks and wanted to give every metal in the game that treatment. As well as adding to the base copper set.

***

**Adds:**

*   Framed glass
*   Mesh blocks/doors/fences
*   Buttons/Pressure plates
*   More flame colors.

**Included metal sets:**

*   Iron
*   Blue Iron (Darker iron set to match vanilla lantern look)
*   Gold
*   Netherite

***

### Future Plans:

*   Addons for industrial/steampunk/magic themed blocks
*   Integration Addons for Create/Tech Reborn/Mythic Metals.
